title: Systematic Parameter Setting for Injection Molding

headline.value: SYSTEMATIC PARAMETER SETTING FOR INJECTION MOLDING
headline.note: Trainer's draft. Uses MOLDING, matching content/modules.json and differing from M3's headline spelling - flagged for a decision rather than silently changed.

promise.value: Introduce a consistent framework for parameter-setting decisions.

items.title: Settings differ by person
items.description: the same mould is set up differently on every shift.

items.title: Changes without a reason
items.description: parameters are changed with no stated intent.

items.title: Several changes at once
items.description: the team cannot tell which action worked.

items.title: No agreed order of decisions
items.description: setting discussions jump randomly between parameters.

items.title: Copied setups
items.description: values from a similar job are reused without checking the conditions.

items.title: Reasoning not recorded
items.description: the next person inherits numbers but not the logic.

items.title: More consistent setups
items.description: one method across shifts and personnel.

items.title: Clearer setting discussions
items.description: production, quality and engineering use the same logic.

items.title: Fewer unexplained changes
items.description: every change has an intent and a recorded response.

items.title: Better setup records
items.description: decisions can be followed and reviewed.

items.title: Less dependence on individuals
items.description: the method belongs to the team, not one person.

rows.after: Change one thing at a time with a stated intent
Decide settings from plastic conditions and evidence
Rationale recorded for the next person

items.title: Explain the logic of each major parameter group
items.description: In terms of the four plastic conditions.

items.title: Follow a structured method for deciding and ordering settings
items.description: Apply the method rather than adjusting at random.

items.title: Justify a parameter decision with evidence and a clear intent
items.description: State what the change is for and what supports it.

items.title: Apply controlled changes and record the process response
items.description: One change at a time, with its effect written down.

items.title: Communicate and document setting decisions so others can follow them
items.description: Hand over the reasoning, not only the numbers.

managementTakeaway.value: A consistent method turns parameter setting from personal habit into shared engineering capability.
